description: Source code for FreeType's TrueTypeGX/AAT table validation functions, including validation and freeing routines for GX and ClassicKern tables.

methods.name: FT_TrueTypeGX_Validate
methods.description: Validates TrueType GX/AAT tables for a given face with specified flags.

methods.name: FT_TrueTypeGX_Free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a TrueType GX/AAT table.

methods.name: FT_ClassicKern_Validate
methods.description: Validates ClassicKern table for a given face with specified flags.

methods.name: FT_ClassicKern_Free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a ClassicKern table.
